description: The plot illustrates how the ROUGE-1 score changes when fine-tuning two models (T5 and MBart) using two adapter methods (LoRA and AdaLoRA) across different values of adapter rank parameter \(r\) on the Gazeta dataset. The x-axis is labeled “\(\log r\)” and uses a linear scale with values shown from 0 to 9, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis is labeled “ROUGE-1” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 35, with major ticks at 5-point intervals. Four solid lines with circular markers are shown: the red line (T5 + LoRA) starts near 23.2 at \(\log r=0\), increases slightly to about 24.5 by \(\log r=6\)–7, and ends around 24.2 at \(\log r=9\) with only small fluctuations throughout. The blue line (MBart + LoRA) begins near 4.8 at \(\log r=0\), rises to about 8.0 at 1, drops to roughly 2.5 at 2, then climbs steadily to about 18.9 at 4 and about 22.6 at 5, reaching around 24.0 at 8 before ending near 23.3 at 9. The green line (T5 + AdaLoRA) starts around 23.2 at \(\log r=0\), increases gradually through about 25.6 at 3 and 27.0 at 4, then rises to about 29.0 at 5 and approaches about 30.1 by 9, showing a steady upward trend across the axis. The orange line (MBart + AdaLoRA) starts near 4.8 at \(\log r=0\), increases to about 9.2 at 1 and 13.4 at 2, reaches about 19.5 at 3, jumps to about 31.9 at 4, and then increases slightly and levels off around 33.2–33.4 from \(\log r=6\) through 9.
